title: New Gitea RCE Lets Repository Writers Plant a Git Hook to Run Shell Commands
summary: Gitea, the self-hosted Git platform, has patched a critical remote code execution vulnerability. A user with ordinary repository write access can turn attacker-controlled patch content into a live Git hook and run shell commands as the Gitea service account.

Referenced vulnerabilities: CVE-2026-60004.
